banner.title: sabnzbd
banner.tagline: Downloads NZBs from Usenet, repairs and unpacks them, and leaves each finished job in the category folder the *arr apps import from.

explainer.title: From an NZB to a finished download

steps.title: Queue
steps.text: Radarr, Sonarr, Shelfmark or a manual add sends an NZB to the SABnzbd API. The client settings live in the config claim.
steps.scene: an inbox receiving a paper packet

steps.title: Fetch
steps.text: Articles land in sabnzbd-incomplete, a 1.5 TB ceph-block scratch volume, which keeps the thousands of small article files off CephFS.
steps.scene: data fragments flowing into a scratch tray

steps.title: Repair
steps.text: par2 verifies and repairs the set, and unrar or 7zip extracts it. Large UHD remuxes need the full 10 GB memory limit.
steps.scene: a repair kit patching a torn archive

steps.title: Complete
steps.text: The finished job moves into usenet/complete/<category> on shared-downloads, the CephFS RWX claim the *arr apps read.
steps.scene: a labelled folder arriving on a shared shelf

steps.title: Back up
steps.text: kopiur snapshots sabnzbd-config to Ceph every four hours and to R2 daily. The incomplete volume is scratch and is not backed up.
steps.scene: a shield over a cube and a cloud
